text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0825 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on lower CBOT soycomplex calls and overbought sentiments from Wednesday's close. But technical support seen in the November at C$360.70, then C$359.60. November WCE canola crush profit margin fell to -23.49 Wednesday from -20.78 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened firm at C$1.3896, rose to 83.76 yen and fell to 1.3187 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.30 to C$0.80 a tonne lower on lower CBOT corn calls.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne down on spillover pressure from WCE barley and CBOT corn calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
